description:
Tandem riding with the power of electric. The EVRYjourney Tandem Electric Trike seats two passengers comfortably, allowing friends or loved ones to ride together. The 750 watt rear hub motor can power riders all over town including up hills. The back rider can choose to take a break and position their feet on the footrest while their front counterpart takes on the work load. If both riders want a break, the front person can simply twist the throttle and the tandem rolls without any effort. The rear differential keeps all three wheels safely balanced on the ground. The large rear basket has plenty of cargo storage for groceries.

The rear wheels make this tandem incredibly stable, there's no need for the riders to balance. The 3" wide tires keep all three wheels firmly on the ground whether turning or on a straight away. With a 550 weight capacity adults can have a great time riding around the neighborhood, picking up groceries or to get some exercise.

750 Watt Rear Hub Motor That Powers Riders Up Hills & Top Speeds of 16mph

Rear Differential that Stabilizes the Rear Wheels and Creates a Safe Balanced Ride

Ergonomic, Upright Riding Position to Reduce Strain on Back, Hips, Shoulders, and Knees

3 Hydraulic Disc Brakes, 1 in front, 2 in Rear for "Stop on a Dime" Braking Power

Huge Rear Cargo Basket and Custom Basket Bags Options Available (Sold Separately)

Battery Compliant to the UL 2271 Standard as Tested by ACT Labs

The advanced rear differential on this 3 wheel ebike ensures power is distributed evenly to both rear wheels when pedaling. Turns on this e trike are smooth as butter and balanced. Both wheels in the rear will be getting power gluing the wheels to ground with unbelievable traction. Ultimately making turns on this 3 wheeled electric bike incredible safe and stable.

State-of-the-Art Rear Differential that Stabilizes the Rear Wheels and Creates a Safe Balanced Ride

Take Turns Knowing the Traction Will be Amazing Around Corners

All Three Tires Stayed Glued to Riding Surface

Ride Through Grass and Trails Easily with Both Rear Wheels Receiving Power
